fib: ______ is the exercise that increases the body strength, speed, endurance or any other physical attribute.
Conditioning exercise
Conditioning exercise is the exercise that increases the body strength, speed, endurance or any other physical attribute.
______ is the coming of an athlete into hard contact with object or another person which can cause damage to connective tissue or joint causing dislocation.
Impact
Impact is the coming of an athlete into hard contact with object or another person which can cause damage to connective tissue or joint causing dislocation.
______ is the science that studies the effects of internal and external force on human performance.
Biomechanical analysis in physical education
Biomechanical analysis in physical education is the science that studies the effects of internal and external force on human performance.
______ is defined as damage to the tissues of the body that occurs as a result of sport or exercise (Engebretsen, Laprade, Mccrory & Meeuwisse, 2012).
sports injury
A sports injury is defined as damage to the tissues of the body that occurs as a result of sport or exercise (Engebretsen, Laprade, Mccrory & Meeuwisse, 2012).
______ is a way of improving performance and preventing injury.
Training to acquire relevant skill
Training to acquire relevant skill is a way of improving performance and preventing injury.
______ is the process of training to become physically fit by a regimen of exercise.
Conditioning
Conditioning is the process of training to become physically fit by a regimen of exercise.
______ is a person's level of adaptability and capability of living a certain lifestyle.
Fitness
Fitness is a person's level of adaptability and capability of living a certain lifestyle.
______ is the result of repetitive micro trauma to tendons, bones, and joints (Matava, 2019).
Overuse
Overuse is the result of repetitive micro trauma to tendons, bones, and joints (Matava, 2019).
______ is the modification of training to account for an athlete unique capacity for and response to training.
Individualization
Individualization is the modification of training to account for an athlete unique capacity for and response to training.
______ is the act, process or art of imparting knowledge and skill.
Pedagogy
Pedagogy is the act, process or art of imparting knowledge and skill.
______ is the range of motion at the joint.
Flexibility
Flexibility is the range of motion at the joint.
______ is the most common causes of poor technique and performance.
Restricted flexibility
Restricted flexibility is the most common causes of poor technique and performance.
